newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES UP IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES UP IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed up 0.30 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 599.29 from 597.48 on Thursday.
Traded volume was 789,750 dinars against 934,000 dinars.
Chemical firm ICF was up one dinar to 65.5 dinars. BNA bank was down 0.96 dinar to 30.99 dinars. Banque du Sud eased 0.7 dinar to 24.2 dinars.
